title: Inverse Resonance Problem for the Half-Line Schrödinger Operator with a Complex Robin Boundary Condition
summary: We study the inverse resonance problem for the one-dimensional Schrödinger operator on the half-line with a compactly supported complex-valued potential and a complex Robin boundary condition \[ u'(0)-a u(0)=0,\qquad a\in\mathbb C. \] The proof follows the transformation-operator, entire-function, and Fourier analytic strategy developed by Marletta, Shterenberg and Weikard for the Dirichlet problem \cite{MSW}. The Dirichlet Jost function $ψ(z,0)$ is replaced by the Robin characteristic function \[ F_a(z;q)=ψ_x(z,0;q)-aψ(z,0;q). \] We establish the corresponding large-energy estimates,…
